svg.title: Rotating Workforce Scheduling search tree (DFS)
svg.text: Partial search tree: 64 of 82 nodes drawn (all nodes up to depth 2 plus the whole solution path and its alternatives).
Dashed boxes stand for branches that exist in the tree but are not drawn.
DFS search: 82 nodes generated, 27 expanded, goal at depth 21.
number = order in which the search expanded the node
Each node is the base schedule: rows R1-R3 (weeks of the rotation), columns Mon-Sun.
Edge label = one cell assignment, e.g. r2 Tue=N (row 2, Tuesday, night shift).
Red nodes show the rule they break (R1-R6, see docs/workforce_scheduling.md).
